title: otiophora scabra subsp. diffusa
intro: Otiophora scabra subsp. diffusa, commonly known as African sandalwood or Cape sandalwood, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Otiophora scabra subsp. diffusa include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
